doc:
Post module for the MySocial network
 Handles creation and management of posts and comments
 Implements features like comments, reposts, and quotes

has_flag.doc: Helper: check if a bit is set in a bitfield

set_flag.doc: Helper: set a bit in a bitfield

clear_flag.doc: Helper: clear a bit in a bitfield

allow_comments.doc: Query: check if comments are allowed

allow_reactions.doc: Query: check if reactions are allowed

allow_reposts.doc: Query: check if reposts are allowed

allow_quotes.doc: Query: check if quotes are allowed

allow_tips.doc: Query: check if tips are allowed

is_spt_enabled.doc: Query: check if SPT is enabled for this post

is_poc_enabled.doc: Query: check if PoC is enabled for this post

is_spot_enabled.doc: Query: check if SPoT is enabled for this post

poc_outcome.doc: Expose on-post PoC outcome for other modules (e.g. social_proof_tokens).

poc_redirection_kind.doc: How derivative redirect is routed for this post (`POC_REDIRECT_*`).

poc_disputes_submitted.doc: Lifetime count of successful PoC dispute submissions (capped at 2 on-chain).

tip_post_requires_beneficiary_vault_for_.doc:
Returns true when [`tip_post`] must receive a [`PoCBeneficiaryVault`] whose beneficiary is `revenue_redirect_to`
 for this tip amount (escrow-mode redirect with a non-zero redirected slice of `tip_amount`).

poc_redirection_none.doc: Sentinel: no derivative redirect kind (original badge path).

get_poc_badge.doc: Get PoC badge snapshot (returns reference to Option).

has_poc_badge.doc: Check if post has PoC badge snapshot or linked badge object

get_poc_evidence_urls.doc: Get PoC evidence URLs (immutable query function)

get_poc_similarity_score.doc: Get PoC similarity score (immutable query function)

get_poc_media_type.doc: Get PoC media type (immutable query function)

get_poc_oracle_address.doc: Get PoC oracle address (immutable query function)

get_poc_analyzed_at.doc: Get PoC analysis timestamp (immutable query function)

get_spot_id.doc: Get the SPoT record ID for a post

get_spt_id.doc: Get the SPT pool ID for a post

set_spot_id.doc: Internal function to set SPoT record ID (package visibility only)

set_spt_id.doc: Internal function to set SPT pool ID (package visibility only)

bootstrap_init.doc: Bootstrap initialization function - creates the post configuration

convert_urls_to_strings.doc: Convert Option<vector<Url>> to Option<vector<String>> for events

resolve_social_actor.doc: Resolve social actor: capability, principal platform join, block list, and approval gate.

create_post_internal.doc: Internal function to create a post and return its ID

assert_mydata_id_allowed_for_owner.doc: When `mydata_id` is set, it must be registered in `mydata_registry` and owned by `owner`.

create_post.doc: Create a new post with interaction permissions

create_comment.doc:
Create a comment on a post or a reply to another comment
 Returns the ID of the created comment

create_repost.doc:
Create a repost or quote repost depending on provided parameters
 If content is provided, it's treated as a quote repost
 If content is empty/none, it's treated as a standard repost

delete_post.doc: Delete a post owned by the caller

delete_comment.doc: Delete a comment owned by the caller

react_to_post.doc:
React to a post with a specific reaction (emoji or text)
 If the user already has the exact same reaction, it will be removed (toggle behavior)

tip_post.doc:
Tip a post creator with coin type `T`. When this post uses vault-mode PoC redirect (`POC_REDIRECT_ESCROW`)
 with a non-zero redirected slice for the given `amount`, `beneficiary_vault` must be the shared vault whose
 beneficiary is `post.revenue_redirect_to` (use an indexer query such as `pocBeneficiaryVaultByBeneficiary`, not
 necessarily the post owner’s vault).

tip_post_simple.doc:
Like [`tip_post`] but without a `PoCBeneficiaryVault` argument. Only for posts where
 [`tip_post_requires_beneficiary_vault_for_amount`] is false for this `amount` (e.g. no redirect,
 wallet redirect, zero redirect %, or escrow with a zero redirected slice from rounding).
 If an escrow deposit is required, aborts with [`ETipPostRequiresBeneficiaryVault`].

apply_poc_redirection_coin.doc: PoC derivative redirect for tips and fees: escrow deposits into `PoCBeneficiaryVault` or wallet redirect.

apply_poc_redirection_coin_without_benef.doc: Same as [`apply_poc_redirection_coin`] for tip paths that never deposit into an escrow vault for this `amount`.

update_poc_result.doc: Internal function to update PoC result (called only from proof_of_creativity module)

set_poc_badge_object_id.doc: Links the post to the authoritative shared `PoCBadgeObject` (after mint + share).

clear_poc_data.doc: Clears PoC redirect + badge pointers on the post after dispute resolution (vault balances are unaffected).

deposit_coin_to_beneficiary_vault.doc: Deposit redirected reservation/trading fees into the beneficiary vault when the post uses vault-mode redirect.

tip_repost.doc:
Tip a repost or quote repost; splits per `PostConfig` between repost owner and original author.
 Pass the shared `PoCBeneficiaryVault` for each post when that post uses `POC_REDIRECT_ESCROW`.

tip_comment.doc: Tip a comment; split per `PostConfig` with PoC redirection on the post owner's share (vault when escrow).

transfer_post_ownership.doc: Transfer post ownership to another user (by post owner)

admin_transfer_post_ownership.doc: Admin function to transfer post ownership (requires PostAdminCap)

react_to_comment.doc:
React to a comment with a specific reaction (emoji or text)
 If the user already has the exact same reaction, it will be removed (toggle behavior)

get_id_address.doc: Get the ID address of a post

get_reaction_count.doc: Get the reaction count of a post

get_tips_received.doc: Get the tips received for a post

get_platform_id.doc: Get the platform ID for a post

get_revenue_redirect_to.doc: Get the revenue redirect address for a post

get_revenue_redirect_percentage.doc: Get the revenue redirect percentage for a post

version.doc: Get the version of a post

borrow_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the post version (for upgrade module)

comment_version.doc: Get the version of a comment

borrow_comment_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the comment version (for upgrade module)

repost_version.doc: Get the version of a repost

borrow_repost_version_mut.doc: Get a mutable reference to the repost version (for upgrade module)

create_promoted_post.doc: Create a promoted post with MYSO tokens for viewer payments

confirm_promoted_post_view.doc: Confirm a user has viewed a promoted post and pay them (platform only)

toggle_promotion_status.doc:
Toggle promotion status (platform can activate, both platform and owner can deactivate)
 Use with activate: false to deactivate promotions

withdraw_promotion_funds.doc: Withdraw all MYSO tokens from promotion (owner only, deactivates promotion)

get_promotion_stats.doc: Get promotion statistics for a post

has_user_viewed_promoted_post.doc: Check if a user has already been paid for viewing a promoted post

get_promotion_id.doc: Get the promotion ID from a post

set_moderation_status.doc: Set moderation status for a post (platform devs/mods only)

is_content_approved.doc: Check if content is approved (not flagged)

create_post_admin_cap.doc:
Create a PostAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)
 This function is only callable by other modules in the same package

PoCBadgeSnapshot.doc: Denormalized PoC badge fields cached on `Post` for cheap reads; authoritative record is `PoCBadgeObject`.

Post.doc: Post object that contains content information

profile_id.doc: Author's profile ID (reference only, not ownership)

platform_id.doc: Platform ID where this post was created

parent_post_id.doc: Optional parent post ID for replies or quote reposts

tips_received.doc: Total tips received in MYSO (tracking only, not actual balance)

removed_from_platform.doc: Whether the post has been removed from its platform

user_reactions.doc: Table of user wallet addresses to their reactions (emoji or text)

reaction_counts.doc: Table to count reactions by type

permissions.doc: Permission flags bitfield: allow_comments (bit 0), allow_reactions (bit 1), allow_reposts (bit 2), allow_quotes (bit 3), allow_tips (bit 4)

revenue_redirect_to.doc: Optional revenue redirection to original creator (for derivative content)

poc_badge_snapshot.doc: Cached PoC badge snapshot (authoritative object id below).

poc_badge_object_id.doc: Address of the shared `PoCBadgeObject` when issued (authoritative PoC record).

mydata_id.doc: Reference to the MyData for the post

promotion_id.doc: Optional promotion data ID for promoted posts

enable_flags.doc: Enable flags bitfield: enable_spt (bit 0), enable_poc (bit 1), enable_spot (bit 2)

spot_id.doc: Optional Social Proof of Truth record ID (address of SpotRecord object)

spt_id.doc: Optional Social Proof Token pool ID (address of TokenPool object)

poc_outcome.doc: Last applied PoC outcome (`POC_OUTCOME_*`); 0 if never analyzed or cleared

poc_redirection_kind.doc: Where derivative redirect slices go for this post (`POC_REDIRECT_*`)

poc_disputes_submitted.doc: Successful PoC dispute submissions for this post (max 2 lifetime; not reset when PoC cleared).

PostAttribution.doc: Published-action attribution stored as a dynamic field (Post is at the VM field-count limit).

Comment.doc: Comment object for posts, supporting nested comments

post_id.doc: The post this comment belongs to

parent_comment_id.doc: Optional parent comment ID for nested comments

profile_id.doc: Commenter's profile ID (reference only, not ownership)

tips_received.doc: Total tips received in MYSO (tracking only, not actual balance)

removed_from_platform.doc: Whether the comment has been removed from its platform

user_reactions.doc: Table of user wallet addresses to their reactions (emoji or text)

reaction_counts.doc: Table to count reactions by type

is_original_post.doc: Whether the original is a post (true) or comment (false)

profile_id.doc: Reposter's profile ID (reference only, not ownership)

payment_per_view.doc: Amount of MYSO to pay per view

paid_viewers.doc: Table tracking which users have already been paid for viewing

views.doc: List of all views for analytics

active.doc: Whether the promotion is currently active

max_content_length.doc: Maximum character length for post content

max_media_urls.doc: Maximum number of media URLs per post

max_mentions.doc: Maximum number of mentions in a post

max_metadata_size.doc: Maximum size for post metadata in bytes

commenter_tip_percentage.doc: Percentage of tip that goes to commenter (remainder to post owner)

repost_tip_percentage.doc: Percentage of tip that goes to reposter (remainder to original post owner)

PostParametersUpdatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when post parameters are updated

PromotedPostCreatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a promoted post is created

PromotedPostViewConfirmedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a promoted post view is confirmed and payment is made

PromotionStatusToggledEvent.doc: Event emitted when promotion status is toggled

PromotionFundsWithdrawnEvent.doc: Event emitted when promotion funds are withdrawn

ModerationRecord.doc: Simple moderation record for tracking moderation decisions
